  "title": "Pseudonymization of sensitive data [3+2]",
  "body": "Prerequisite: #1158\r\n\r\nNEW USER RIGHTS: SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_JURISDICTION & SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION\r\n=> Prevent users WITHOUT this right from seeing:\r\n  * Tasks assigned to users on district level or below (Community, Health facility, point of entry)\r\n  * User names of personnel on district level or below (username, first & lastname)\r\n  * Any location information below district level (e.g. the facility of a case)\r\n  * Names of laboratories where samples have been sent to\r\n  * All fields that allow users to type in free text\r\n  * Detailed information about the employee status of cases or contacts\r\n\r\nThe default should probably be that every user has the SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_JURISDICTION user right and nobody has the SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION user right. German servers will need to be manually adjusted.\r\n\r\n### Review\r\n@MartinWahnschaffeSymeda ",
